surah.personality_title: Al-Falaq — The Cleaving Dawn & Sanctuary from External Malice
surah.personality_summary: Protective, apotropaic, luminous, shielding. Seeking refuge with the Lord of the Daybreak from the dangers of the external physical and metaphysical world: the evil of created things, the enshrouding darkness of the night, the sorcerers blowing on knots, and the destructive poison of the envious when he envies.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Falaq (The Dawn) is the 113th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 5 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل اعوذ برب الفلق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak

ayahs.translation_saheeh: From the evil of that which He created
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: against the harm in what He has created

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the harm in the night when darkness gathers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the harm in witches when they blow on knots

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And from the evil of an envier when he envies
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the harm in the envier when he envies.’
